title: Jelly Roll's later years; he never played in her band
summary: Allen describes Jelly Roll's later years; Austin says he worked in the theater but not in her band.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: And he went on to New York. Yes, I did. And then during the Depression he didn't have very good luck. He was in Washington when I met him and playing in a little night club there and helping run the club, but he didn't like it. And he stayed there until 1938. Then he went away back to New York in 39. And I only saw him once in New York up at the rhythm club where the musicians would all hang out. Yes. He played pool there a lot.
Well, I was in New York for a long, long time. Four years I was out there. But I didn't see him.
Did you ever play any jobs with him or did he ever work in your band or anything?
No, he didn't work in my band. He worked with me and Mac's band.
But he worked in the theater where.
